parties.description: Every party to the contract, as the contract names it, with the role the contract gives it.

name.description: The party's name as written, without its address.

role.description: What it is in the contract, such as Supplier, Customer or Guarantor: the contract's own word for the role, not a short name.

term.description: When the contract starts and how long it lasts or when it ends. Null if it says neither.

renewal.description: Whether and how it renews or can be extended. Null if it says nothing about renewal or extension.

notice.description: The notice needed to end it, or to stop it renewing, and who can give it. Null if it gives no notice period.

fees.description: What is paid, how often, when payment is due, and any price changes. Null if it states no fees.
